# Preview

Input: optionally `<slug>`; without it, the site hub opens.

1. A slug without `projects/<slug>/index.html` → list the folders in `projects/` and ask which one.
2. Run `node scripts/pk.mjs serve [slug]` as a background process; it runs until stopped. People start the same server with `npm start`.
3. Report the URL it prints (`http://localhost:3000/…`; the port goes up when 3000 is busy). The browser opens by itself; CSS changes apply without a reload, HTML and JS changes reload the page, Markdown views refresh in place; Ctrl+C or a request stops it.

Needs Node.js 18+ only; nothing is installed or downloaded.

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
